_meta.description: Cross-reference index for the 2023 NBA CBA transaction-rules knowledge base. Lets the app pull in related rules and defined terms when answering a question.
_meta.notes: rule_to_rules: each rule -> its resolved related rule_ids. rule_to_terms: each rule -> the glossary terms it depends on (after case/plural/alias normalization). term_to_rules: reverse index (defined term -> rules that depend on it). unresolved_term_references: depends_on_terms strings with no glossary match even after normalization; these are generic phrases, exhibit-form names, or out-of-scope terms (audit/arbitration/award names) intentionally not in the transaction glossary. dangling_rule_references: related_rule_ids pointing to no existing rule (should be empty).
